files.description: Bike-share stations (48 rows, one per station): station_code (four-digit code with leading zeros, e.g. "0040"), station_name (text, a few with accented letters), district (same 6 districts as riders.csv; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), docks (whole number), opened_on (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD).

task_text: In stations.csv, find the two stations with the most docks in each district (district trimmed and lower-cased). `result` should be a table with columns district, station_code (text, leading zeros kept), station_name and docks, twelve rows, sorted by district alphabetically, then docks from most to fewest, ties broken by the earlier opened_on and then the smaller station_code.
intended_computation: Read stations.csv keeping station_code as text; clean district (strip, lower case); per district the two stations with the most docks (ties: earlier opened_on, then smaller station_code); columns district, station_code, station_name, docks; 12 rows sorted by district ascending, docks descending, opened_on ascending, station_code ascending.

acceptable_variants.notes: id columns (rider_id, station codes) may be written as integers without leading zeros
